depictions.label: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI)
depictions.description: Characters use direct neural interfaces to connect their brains directly to cyberspace, experiencing it as reality.
depictions.note: Re-mapped (#78): Neuromancer's direct neural interfaces: brain-computer interfaces (the general page).

depictions.label: Quantum Computing
depictions.description: The underlying infrastructure of cyberspace relies on quantum computing principles for its vast computational power.

depictions.label: Virtual Reality
depictions.description: Cyberspace is depicted as a three-dimensional spatial environment where users navigate and interact.
depictions.note: Re-mapped (#78): Holodeck, cyberspace, the Wired, shared dreamscapes, virtual afterlives: immersive virtual environments.

depictions.label: Blockchain
depictions.description: The Matrix represents a decentralized network of interconnected systems, similar to blockchain architecture.
depictions.note: Re-mapped (#78): The connection names a decentralized network like blockchain: the general blockchain page.

depictions.label: Predictive Threat Intelligence Platforms
depictions.description: Psychohistory uses statistical models to predict the fall of empires, similar to advanced threat forecasting.

depictions.label: Causal Inference Engines
depictions.description: Seldon's Plan relies on understanding complex causal chains in human history to guide civilization.

depictions.label: Spatial Computing
depictions.description: The Metaverse is a shared 3D virtual space, a direct precursor to modern spatial computing and VR.

depictions.label: Persistent AR Cloud Layers
depictions.description: Digital information is overlaid on the physical world, foreshadowing AR cloud technologies.

depictions.label: Quantum-Secure Communications
depictions.description: Sophons interfere with particle accelerators and communicate instantaneously, related to quantum entanglement concepts.

depictions.label: Haptic Feedback Suits
depictions.description: The V-suit allows players to feel heat, cold, and physical impacts within the Three-Body game.

depictions.label: Atmospheric Water-Harvesting Textiles
depictions.description: Stillsuits reclaim moisture from the body, critical for survival on the desert planet Arrakis.

depictions.label: Memory Enhancement Protocols
depictions.description: Mentats are human computers trained to perform immense mental calculations, replacing thinking machines.

depictions.label: Active Protection Systems
depictions.description: Holtzman shields use force fields to stop fast-moving projectiles, changing the nature of warfare.

depictions.label: Emotion Recognition Systems

depictions.label: General Purpose Robot

depictions.label: Alignment in Distributed Cognition
